column1: # nardol target list (DRAFT - hosts not yet verified; see README)
# Format: TSV (real tab characters). Lines starting with '#' are comments.
#  - Entries sharing a region_id form an ordered fallback group; file order = probe priority.
#  - Exactly one 'primary' per region (the first line); the rest are 'fallback'.
#  - Targets must be unicast and physically located in/near the stated city. No anycast (1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8, big CDNs).
#  - lat/lon describe the region (city), not the individual host.
#    vultr=*-ping.vultr.com, digitalocean/linode/hetzner=public speedtest hosts, edu=university web hosts.
#  - GCP and Azure are intentionally omitted: no clean public per-region unicast endpoint (Google Front End is anycast-like).
#  - edu hosts may sit behind a CDN; the weekly list-health job should flag any whose RTT looks too low for the distance.
